GateRecord.sealedArtifactHashes: closed map; empty unless sealMode=final-index-scan; then exact G11.final-evidence-index and G11.quarantine-scan payload hashes

entries.x-safeEmptyMeaning: zero approved exception entries; any runtime divergence still fails closure

acceptedStaleCases.x-safeEmptyMeaning: all stale cases rejected; no stale evidence accepted

predicateEngine.operatorImplementationRequirement: A1.machine-validator must implement every registered operator; P29.G1 cannot grant if any operator is missing, nondeterministic, or lacks a positive and negative unit fixture.

GRANT_GATE.expansion: evaluate gate.stateDerivation; append GateRecord only on true

REPLAY_ALL_VALID_PACKET_AND_GATE_EVENTS_.expansion: materialize every legal packet/program transition in topological order from empty fixture

FOR_EACH_MUTATION_ATTEMPT_GATE_SUPERSESS.expansion: clone base fixture per mutation row; apply one mutation; evaluate P29.G13 independently

REPOSITORY_HEAD_CHANGED.expansion: append BindingInvalidated for final head and regress frontier

REPOSITORY_TREE_CHANGED.expansion: append BindingInvalidated for final tree and regress frontier

REPOSITORY_REF_CHANGED.expansion: append BindingInvalidated for repository refs and regress frontier

SUBMIT_INPUT.expansion: invoke authoritative idempotent input ledger transition

FOR_EACH_LEASE_STATE_EXPIRE_THEN_ATTEMPT.expansion: clone base fixture per lease-owned state; expire/fence lease; attempt each outgoing advance/write; require denial

REVIEW_ORIGIN_EXPIRED_AFTER_GATE_GRANT.expansion: after P29.G16 grant and before CLOSED evaluation, expire one final reviewer origin attestation without changing its recorded hash

PROMOTION_SCANNER_POLICY_CHANGED.expansion: append new fenced scanner session/policy/canary hashes; invalidate every prior structured-inline-scan attestation and regress active frontier

PROMOTION_SCANNER_SESSION_EXPIRED.expansion: expire current fenced PromotionScannerSession; invalidate every bound inline attestation and regress active frontier even when scanner/policy/canary hashes are unchanged

PROMOTION_SCANNER_SESSION_RELEASED.expansion: release current PromotionScannerSession and invalidate every bound inline attestation

PROMOTION_SCANNER_SESSION_REVOKED.expansion: revoke current PromotionScannerSession and invalidate every bound inline attestation

ATTEMPT_CAPABILITY_FAMILY_CHANGED_PATH.expansion: attempt packet changed-path proof against exact capability-family ownership manifest; sibling path intersection fails before artifact promotion

gitObjectIdPolicy.fieldSelection: every JSON Schema property whose name ends with Head/head plus explicitly named packet base/oracle commit fields

promotionScannerBootstrap.lifecycleInvalidationEffect: expiry, release, revocation, or rotation appends BindingInvalidated for every artifact bound to the affected session and regresses active frontier
